name: Data-Analyzer
description: The Qualitative Data Analysis Tool is a powerful Streamlit application designed for researchers to analyze word frequencies in corporate documents. This tool processes PDF reports, identifies target words and their contextually relevant synonyms, and generates comprehensive reports with document statistics, summary analysis, and per-file breakdowns
